subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: Should maintainers replace the conflicting fork PR with a narrow same-repo schema repair, adopt that fork manually, or wait for the fork author to rebase it?
rationale: The bug is valid and small, but an open non-maintainer fork PR claims the exact fix while conflicting and not maintainer-editable, so automation should not start a competing PR without maintainer direction.

options.title: Replace with narrow repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork candidate and land a same-repo patch that only moves `approvalRunningNoticeMs` into `ToolExecBaseShape` plus required schema/test updates.

options.title: Adopt the fork manually
options.body: Ask a maintainer to rework the fork PR, resolving conflicts and dropping unrelated daemon/systemd changes before review.

options.title: Wait on fork author
options.body: Leave this issue blocked on the fork author to rebase and prove the branch, keeping the bug open meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Replace with narrow repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork candidate and land a same-repo patch that only moves `approvalRunningNoticeMs` into `ToolExecBaseShape` plus required schema/test updates.

likelyOwner.reason: The central docs/config behavior appears to date to `steipete`'s commit and that history makes this the best available routing owner for the schema/docs decision.
